meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: Claude 可以自动打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截图、提取数据，并执行 JavaScript 代码。
howto.when: 当你需要浏览网页、获取在线信息或与网页交互时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图全页。
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存全页截图。

say.text: 搜索“最新科技新闻”并提取前三篇标题。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并提取结果。

say.text: 帮我填写登录表单，用户名为 admin，密码为 123456。
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框并填写。

howto.what_en: Claude can open web pages, click links, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and run JavaScript automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to browse the web, get online information, or interact with web pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a full screenshot.

say_en.text: Search for 'latest tech news' and extract the top three headlines.
say_en.note: Claude will search and extract results.

say_en.text: Fill in the login form with username 'admin' and password '123456'.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the inputs and fill them.
